parts: A private marketplace for physical commodities.
In commodity trading, it is often hard to know who is on the other side.
Showing your position too early can weaken your commercial standing.
Members post buying and selling opportunities with the key details: commodity, quantity, origin and Incoterm.
Each member states their role and declares the documentation available.
Other members see the opportunity, not the member's identity.
All communication passes through the Operator.
Introduction follows only once both sides agree on the essential terms and wish to proceed.
The platform does not verify members, documents or transactions.
Each member stands behind their own statements.
We are remunerated by a success fee, payable only when an introduction leads to a successful conclusion, as defined and agreed in advance in the per-deal agreement.
